01 / THE INTENT

Follow the light
Leave room for discovery

A personal short film built around the urge to explore. Ordinary moments and changing landscapes become material for a freely composed cinematic journey, without a commercial brief or a fixed formula.

The aim is to test how far AI can produce cinematic footage—and whether it can express the idea and feeling intended by its director.

02 / CREATIVE DIRECTION

04 / CREATIVE EXPLORATION
Freedom begins with a way of seeing

The experiment asks how far AI-generated imagery and motion can carry cinematic intention. The focus is expressive fidelity: whether a frame, its movement and the edit communicate the feeling originally imagined.
